# Hardleaf — Coding Chronicles

A 3D skyline visualization of the Hardleaf repository's evolution. Each tower is a
commit; height is lines changed, color is the add/delete balance, and the camera
flies down the avenue of time while commit messages surface in the ticker.

## How the data flow works

The page loads `commits.json` (fetched next to `index.html`) on open. That file is
**generated by a GitHub Action and published with the Pages deployment** — it is
never committed to the repository. If `commits.json` is missing (e.g. opening the
HTML locally), the page falls back to built-in demo data, so it always renders.

This app does **not** have its own Pages deployment. GitHub Pages allows only one
deployment per repo, and that slot is owned by the main `web_app` (Vite) site. To
avoid clobbering it, the skyline is built as a step inside the main deploy workflow
and dropped into a `chronicles/` subfolder of the main app's `dist/`:

```
repo/
├─ web_app/
│  └─ chronicles/
│     ├─ index.html              # this page (deployed at /chronicles/index.html)
│     ├─ build-commits.mjs       # generates commits.json from git history
│     └─ README.md               # you are here
└─ .github/workflows/
   └─ deploy.yml                 # builds web_app + this skyline, deploys both
```

The relevant steps in [`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`](../../.github/workflows/deploy.yml):

```yaml
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
  with:
    fetch-depth: 0              # generator needs full commit history
# ...build main app into web_app/dist...
- run: |
    mkdir -p web_app/dist/chronicles
    cp web_app/chronicles/index.html web_app/dist/chronicles/index.html
    node web_app/chronicles/build-commits.mjs --out web_app/dist/chronicles/commits.json
```

So the main app stays at the site root and the skyline is served at the
`/chronicles/` subpath, e.g.
`https://<owner>.github.io/coding_architecture_fs26_focus_work/chronicles/`.
Because the page fetches `./commits.json` (relative), the subpath needs no code change.

The workflow runs on every push to `main`, once daily, and on manual dispatch, so the
skyline stays current with no manual step.

## Local preview

`commits.json` won't exist locally, so the page shows demo data. To preview against
real data, generate it yourself and serve the folder (a plain file:// open will not
fetch JSON in some browsers):

```bash
# from web_app/chronicles/
node build-commits.mjs --out commits.json
python3 -m http.server 8000     # then visit http://localhost:8000/index.html
```

## Options

- **Full history vs. trailing month.** The workflow generates full history by
  default. For only the last 30 days, change the generate step in `deploy.yml` to:
  `node web_app/chronicles/build-commits.mjs --since "30 days ago" --out web_app/dist/chronicles/commits.json`
- **Manual override.** The "Load your repo" drawer in the page still works for
  pasting any `git log` output by hand.
